summary: A decades-old five-storey building at 45J Ma Tau Wai Road in Hung Hom collapsed at about 1:30pm on Friday while a ground-floor shop was undergoing renovations, leaving the street full of dust and prompting firefighters to search for survivors and order evacuations of nearby buildings 45G and 45H. The government confirmed four people were dead, said rescue efforts ended on Saturday morning with no one missing, and the police have begun investigating; Secretary for Development Carrie Lam visited the scene on Saturday afternoon to seek advice from the police and Buildings Department and Secretary for Labour & Welfare Matthew Cheung said the government would do its best to meet the victims' needs. Chief Executive Donald Tsang called for an investigation, the government— which had inspected the five-storey structure before the incident and ordered repairs— announced it would require inspections of all similar old buildings and would inspect buildings older than 50 years within one month, and access to 45G and 45H has been restricted.
